name: Open the first case and recover evidence
description: Verifies the primary mystery can be opened and evidence can be examined.
steps: Open Discover from the main navigation
Inspect The final recording evidence card
expected: The case briefing is visible, the final recording is marked recovered, and investigation progress increases.

name: Interview suspects and log an interview
description: Verifies selecting a person of interest displays their statement and allows an interview to be logged.
steps: Select Jonah Reed in Persons of Interest
expected: Jonah Reed's statement and follow-up question are visible, and the interview is marked as logged.

name: Require evidence and interviews before accusation
description: Verifies an accusation cannot be submitted before the minimum investigation requirements are met on mobile.
steps: Open CASE 001 on a mobile viewport
Select a person in the Final Accusation field
Submit the accusation without collecting evidence or interviews
expected: A notice explains that at least 3 evidence items and 2 interviews are required, and no ending is generated.

name: Save and restore authenticated investigation progress
description: Verifies a signed-in investigator can save progress and restore it in a later session.
steps: Sign in using an available provider
Recover The final recording and log an interview
expected: The recovered evidence and logged interview remain visible after the page reloads.

name: Submit an eligible accusation and reopen the case
description: Verifies an eligible investigator receives a narrative case outcome and can reopen the investigation.
steps: Log interviews with at least 2 suspects
Select Mara Voss and submit the accusation
expected: A case update narrative appears, then the accusation and ending clear so the investigation can continue.
